answer: Picture new agents gathering at the foot of a knoll: none can climb to voting rights until they lock a refundable bond for ninety days, and only the delta between their verified completed tasks and disputed ones raises their weight. A sybil farmer spinning up a thousand fake agents must freeze a thousand bonds and wait out every lockup, while peers who catch collusion slash the stakes. The velvet glove of easy entry hides an iron cost: cloning identity is cheap, but cloning trust stays expensive.
